name: confirm_shift_swap
description: confirm_shift_swap: Record a shift swap between two employees. Returns a case_id on success. Rejects the swap if the colleague does not meet certification requirements for the unit.

employee_id.description: The employee ID of the original shift owner. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

shift_id.description: The shift being swapped. Format: SHF-YYYYMMDD-HHMM. If the caller only has the shift date and start time, construct the ID from those (e.g. a shift on May 1, 2026 at 7:00 AM becomes SHF-20260501-0700). Example: SHF-20260501-0700

colleague_employee_id.description: The employee ID of the colleague taking the shift. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP039124

unit_code.description: The unit where the shift takes place. Format: digits+letter-letters. Example: 4B-ICU
